aids.title: 🤖 Smart Robot Training Game (AI Classifier)
aids.desc: An interactive screen to train the robot to distinguish between apples and bananas. Click on images of apples and bananas to provide the robot with data, then test it with a new image to show how artificial intelligence learns!

aids.title: 🎭 Face Landmarks game
aids.desc: Attach sunglasses and a funny hat to a cartoon face by highlighting the vital points (eyes, head) to demonstrate how smart camera filters work.
